tools.name: get_print_service_info
tools.description: Returns FormNord 3D printing service details: materials (PETG, ABS) and colours, infill options (15 light / 20 standard / 40 strong / 100 solid %), print settings, maximum size, pricing model, shipping options and delivery time. Delivery to Norway only.

tools.name: get_print_quote
tools.description: Get an instant price for printing a 3D model (STL, 3MF, or a zip containing them, max 300 mm on the longest side) and shipping it within Norway. Provide exactly one of file_url, file_base64, stl_text, upload_id (from create_upload_link) or file_id. Returns tilbud_id (the quote_id), total price in NO

tools.name: get_quote_status
tools.description: Look up an earlier quote by quote_id: price, whether it has expired, whether it has been ordered, and the order status (awaiting payment, queued, shipped).

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Create a one-time upload page for the user's model file, for when the user has the file (attached in chat or on their device) and you cannot pass its contents to get_print_quote. Give the user upload_url; when they say it is uploaded, call get_print_quote with upload_id. Accepts STL, 3MF or zip up t

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Place an order for a quote on the user's behalf and get a payment link. Only call this after the user has given you their details and explicitly confirmed that they accept the terms (https://formnord.no/print/vilkar) and have the right to use the model.
